terrain.description: Terrain in SFB includes planets, asteroid fields, nebulae, ion storms, and other space phenomena that affect gameplay. Terrain can provide cover, restrict movement, or create hazards.

types.name: Planets
types.description: Celestial bodies that ships can orbit, land on, or use for cover.
effects: Ships can end their turn next to a planet to land.
Landing requires ending the turn next to the planet, being motionless the next turn, and landing at the end of the following turn.
Take-off requires spending a turn 'taking off' and reaching the hex adjacent to the planet on the last impulse.
Planets can provide cover from weapons fire.
Planet killers can destroy planets (rare weapons).

variants.description: Large planet with extended gravity effects.

types.name: Asteroid Fields
types.description: Fields of asteroids that restrict movement and provide cover.
effects: Ships moving through asteroid fields may be damaged or forced to slow down.
Asteroids provide cover from weapons fire.
Movement through asteroid fields is restricted and may require special checks.

types.name: Nebulae
types.description: Clouds of gas and dust that interfere with sensors and weapons.
effects: Cannot reinforce shields in a nebula.
Sensors and scanners are disrupted, reducing detection range.
Weapons fire may be disrupted.
Provides cover and concealment.

types.name: Ion Storms
types.description: Electrical storms that disrupt ship systems.
effects: Disrupt electronic systems, including weapons fire control.
May cause breakdowns or system failures.
Interfere with sensors and communications.

types.name: Tholian Webs
types.description: Web-like structures cast by Tholian ships that restrict movement and fire.
effects: Ships in webbed hexes have restricted movement.
Weapons fire is disrupted for ships in webs.
Webs can be cast in specific patterns to trap pursuers (Web Trap).
Web anchors mark the boundaries of web fields.
Cast webs are pre-deployed web structures.

variants.description: Normal web cast by Tholian ships.
One-hex web cast directly behind the ship to restrict pursuers.

types.name: Minefields
effects: Ships entering mined hexes may trigger mines.
Mines detonate and damage ships.
Types include contact mines, proximity mines, and smart mines.
Minefields can be used to block passages or protect positions.

types.description: Detonate when a ship enters the hex.
Detonate when a ship comes within range.

types.name: Space Amoebas
types.description: Biological hazards — space-faring organisms that attack ships.
effects: Attack ships on contact.
Can damage shields and hull.
Require labs to identify and find vulnerabilities.

types.name: Sun Snakes / Space Dragons
types.description: Large space-faring creatures that can attack ships.
effects: Move independently and attack ships.
Have their own attack and defense capabilities.
Require labs to identify vulnerabilities.

types.name: Gravity Wells
types.description: Areas of intense gravity that affect ship movement.
effects: Ships may be pulled toward the gravity well.
Movement is restricted near gravity wells.
May cause breakdowns if ships attempt to resist.

terrainModules.description: Module B provides maps with pre-printed terrain. Additional terrain rules are in the Master Rulebook.
terrainModules.moduleB: Maps with pre-printed terrain (asteroid fields, gas giants, etc.). Out of print.
